findings.current: Except for the one person it alone had feared—and deliberately avoided because of that fear.
findings.defect: “It alone had feared” suggests the Doppelganger was the only one who feared that person. The source says this was the only person the Doppelganger feared.
findings.rationale: 유일하게 limits the people the Doppelganger feared, not the number of beings who feared Cheon Taemin.
findings.replacement: Except for the one person it had feared—and deliberately avoided because of that fear.
findings.source: 그가 유일하게 두려워했고, 그랬기에 일부러 피해 왔던 한 사람을 제외한다면.

summary: One actionable subject error changes whom the Doppelganger fears.
